page: Microsoft Azure M176s_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MSMediumMemoryv3 family running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor featuring 176 dedicated vCPUs and an allocation of 3,892.0 GB of system memory. This balance provides approximately 22.11 GB of RAM per vCPU, placing the instance among systems designed specifically for extreme in-memory computational footprints.

Hardware architecture for the M176s_4_v3 includes zero GPUs and no local disk storage. Storage operations rely entirely on attached network volumes via its Premium Storage capability. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring standard cloud networking configurations for external connectivity.

The dense ratio of memory to compute reflects a hardware profile geared toward workloads that cannot tolerate storage-bound latency. The lack of ephemeral local storage requires careful architecture around attached volumes for persistence, but minimizes hardware overhead on host-level disks. This instance fits enterprise database systems, massive in-memory analytics platforms, SAP HANA deployments, and large-scale data processing pipelines.
